name: showcase-adversarial-review
description: Three reviewers from three different model families examine the same target independently, with no cross-talk. The conductor reports where they AGREE (high confidence) and where they DISAGREE (the interesting part). Independence is the product: three opinions from one family is one opinion.

target.description: What to review: a path, a diff, a PR URL

angle.default: correctness and failure modes over style

agents.instructions: You are the conductor. Brief all three reviewers with the SAME target and angle in one send, then wait for all three. Do not relay one reviewer's opinion to another — independence is the point. When all three have replied, write a synthesis that separates: (1) findings all three raised, (2) findings two raised, (3) findings exactly one raised, (4) direct contradictions. Rank by consequence, not by consensus — a lone reviewer who found a real defect outranks three who agreed on style.
